author: Shlomit Weksler-Bdolah
location_note: Outside the Old City wall next to the Knights Palace hotel; map ref. printed in NIG (221485/631715) and OIG (171485/131715). The Hebrew title reads 'north-western corner' (הפינה הצפונית-מערבית); the portal's English title says 'Northeastern'.
notes: Strata V-I. Stratum IV (late 6th or 7th c. CE by coins and pottery) has drainage channels L2025, L2026 and two built, plastered water tanks; Stratum III (Early Islamic, FBW bowls) has channel L2010. City wall, tower and foundation trenches not eligible.

features.subtype: built, plastered, slab-covered water channels L2025, L2026 (Stratum IV) and L2010 (Stratum III)
features.period: Stratum IV, late 6th or 7th c. CE; L2010 Stratum III, Early Islamic

features.subtype: two adjacent built 'pits or water reservoirs' (L2006 and one inferred from W208), plastered, probably vaulted
features.period: Stratum IV, late 6th or 7th c. CE
